TERMINATION OF GROUND LEASE, MERGEROFFEEANDLEASEHOLDESTATES ANDTERMINATIONOFMEMORANDUMOFGROUNDLEASE THIS TERMINATION OF GROUND LEASE, MERGER OF FEE AND LEASEHOLD ESTATES AND TERMINATION OF MEMORANDUM OF GROUND LEASE (this "Termination") is made as of this 23rd day of June, 2023 (the “Effective Date"), by AREIT RE HOLDER II LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (as successor-in-interest to Original Estate Investment LLC,31 West 27th Street,12th Floor, New York, New York 10001, and AREIT Ground Lessee (as defined below), “Ground Lessee"), having an address of c/o Argentic Real Estate Investment LLC, 31 West 27th Street, 12th Floor, New York, New York 10001 and consented and agreed to by AREIT WHI LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (as successor- in-interest to Argentic Real Estate Investment LLC, “Mortgagee"), having an address of c/o Argentic Real Estate Investment LLC, 31 West 27th Street, 12th Floor, New York, New York 10001. WHEREAS, Mountbatten Equities L.P., a Delaware limited liability company ("Original Ground Lessor”) and Hudson Leroy LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Original Ground Lessee") entered into that certain Lease dated as of December 15, 2010, with respect to certain real (the “Demised Premises"), as assigned by Original Ground Lessee to 421 Commercial Fitness LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Interim Ground Lessee") pursuant to that certain Assignment, Assumption and Amendment of Ground Lease (Amendment to Ground Lease") dated as of October 18, 2017 and as assigned by Interim Ground Lessee to Ground Lessee pursuant to that certain Assignment and Assumption of Ground Lease Agreement dated as of April 27, 2023 (the “Ground Lease"), the terms of which Ground Lease have been memorialized in that certain Memorandum of Ground Lease dated as of October18,2017 and recorded November 15,2017 as CRFN 2017000420000 in the Office ofthe New York City Register, State of New York (the“City shall have the meanings ascribed to such terms in the Ground Lease. WHEREAS, the Demised Premises are encumbered by that certain Consolidated, Amended and Restated Fee and Leasehold Mortgage, Assignment of Leases and Rents and Security Agreement for the benefit of Mortgagee, dated as of October 18, 2017 and recorded on November 15, 2017 as CRFN 2017102500784007 in the City Register, as amended by that certain First Amendment to Consolidated, Amended and Restated Fee and Leasehold Mortgage, Assignment of Leases and Rents and Security Agreement, dated as of April 6, 2021 and recorded on May 3, 2021 as CRFN 2021000161231 in the City Register. WHEREAS,Ground Lessor and Ground Lessee now desire to terminate the Ground Lease andLeaseMemorandum. 174096179

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing recitals and of other good and valuable consideration,the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged,Ground Lessor and Ground Lessee hereby agree asfollows: 1. Recitals. The foregoing recitals are true and correct, and are hereby incorporated as material terms of this Termination. 2.Merger of Fee and Leasehold Estates. Pursuant to Section 25 of the Amendment to Ground Lease, there shall be no merger of the Ground Lease or the leasehold estate created by the Ground Lease with a fee interest in the Demised Premises by reason of the fact that the same Person may acquire, own or hold, directly or indirectly, the Ground Lease or the leasehold estate created by the Ground Lease and thefeeestate in the Demised Premises, unless and until such Person and every leasehold mortgagee shall join in a written instrument expressly providing for such merger and such instrument is recorded. The Ground Lessor and Ground Lessee, being the same Person holding thefee estate and the leasehoid estate in theDemisedPremises,herebyelect to merge the fee estate and the leasehold estate in the Demised Premises pursuant to Section 25 of the Amendment to Ground Lease, thus terminating the Ground Lease. Mortgagee hereby consents to the foregoing merger of the fee estate and the leasehold estateintheDemisedPremises. 3.Termination of Agreements.Each of the Ground Lease and Lease Memorandum is hereby terminated and is of no further force or effect as of the Effective Date.The Lease Memorandum is hereby terminated and released from the Demised Premises, and shall be discharged of record. 4. Counterparts. This Termination may be executed in one or more counterparts, all of which together shall constitute one and the same instrument. [Remainder of page intentionally blank. Signature page follows.] 174096179
